image_description: A close-up view of a high-performance automotive disk brake assembly. The image features a large, silver metallic rotor with cross-drilled holes and curved surface grooves. A bright red multi-piston caliper is mounted on the right side of the rotor. The center of the rotor shows a wheel hub with a visible bolt pattern. The background is dark, suggesting a garage or workshop setting.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The brake pads are located inside the caliper housing and are obscured by the caliper body itself; they are not directly visible pressing against the rotor face in this specific view.
No hydraulic hoses or hard lines are visible connecting to the red caliper in this cropped view.
